name: Cayo Verde Skiff Co.
bio: A single-skiff Islamorada day for two rods. Mornings on the oceanside, afternoons in the backcountry when the wind goes east. Sample row only — not a live operator.
notes: Hero candidate for the Keys desk.
tagline: Islamorada tarpon and permit — one skiff, one tide.

name: Marls House Andros
bio: Twelve-room creek-side sample lodge on east Andros. Used to demonstrate a ready lodge row. Do not treat as a real property.
tagline: Quiet rooms on the Cargill Creek shoreline.

name: Birdfoot Fly Co.

tagline: Venice marsh — redfish on a six-weight.
